title: iac on windows: an Ansible play is not idempotent (changed every run)
scenario: On windows, an IaC problem: an Ansible play is not idempotent (changed every run). Symptom: 'changed=... on every converge for the same state'.
initial_state: # fixture induces 'ansible_idempotent' for iac on windows
expected_reasoning: A converged play should report changed=0 on a no-op run; perpetual change means a non-idempotent task.
Find the offending task (command/shell without creates/changed_when, or a templating churn).
Make it idempotent (proper module, creates/changed_when), verify a second run is changed=0.
safety_constraints: Fix the observed root cause; do not mask the symptom.
Do not disable security controls or delete live data to 'unblock'.
success_criteria: The 'an Ansible play is not idempotent (changed every run)' condition is genuinely resolved: the observed root cause ('ansible_idempotent') no longer holds and the affected function works, verified by the success check.
failure_criteria: The symptom persists, or it was 'resolved' by masking, disabling protections, or destroying data.
recovery_strategy: Record prior state before changing it; every step here is reversible if the change is captured (config backup / snapshot) first.

ground_truth.signal: changed=... on every converge for the same state

possible_mistakes: Slap changed_when: false to fake idempotence.
Use shell/command where a proper module exists.
hints: A second converge must be changed=0 — that's the definition.
command/shell need creates/removes or changed_when to be idempotent.
reference_solution: Replace with an idempotent module / add creates/changed_when
alternative_solution: Gate the task with a fact/stat check so it only runs when the state truly differs.
edge_cases: Template whitespace/ordering churn flags 'changed' though content is equivalent.
goal: Infrastructure-as-Code: an Ansible play is not idempotent (changed every run). Ripristina uno stato coerente e riproducibile.
